title: Seirei Tsukai no Blade Dance Mini OVAs
justification: AniList: 6 shorts of 3 min, 2014-10-08 to 2015-03-04. AniDB 9999 S1-S6 are six specials with exactly those dates (2014-10-08, 11-05, 12-03, 2015-01-07, 02-04, 03-04). TVDB 279984 season 0 0x1-0x6 "Special Mini OVA 1-6" on the same dates: 1 "Imperial City Spirit Festival" = S1 "The Great Spirit Festival at the Imperial Capital"; 2 "Nurse Est" = S2 "Est, Nursing"; 3 "The Princess' Secret Part-Time Job" = S3; 4 "Find the Legendary Big-Breasted Spirit!" = S4 "Chasing the Legendary Big-Boob Spirit!"; 5 "The Terrible Mystery Hot Pot Battle" = S5 "The Frightening Darkness Hot Pot Battle"; 6 "The Elementalers Take a Break" = S6 "Elementalists on Holiday". Same order. Parent has no mapping list: S<n> defaults to 0x<n>.
